transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I can’t seem to slow down—I’m constantly taking on new projects and working nonstop, like I’m stuck in overdrive. It just feels like I have to keep moving and doing things all the time.
Have you felt this way for most of your life since childhood, or does this feeling of being 'in overdrive' come and go in distinct phases?

No, this definitely isn't a lifelong thing from childhood. It's actually a pretty recent change that's been building and staying intense for about the last seven months, right around when I took on a huge solar contract and started studying nights for my Master Electrician exam.
During these past seven months, is this 'overdrive' driven by constant worry and anxiety, or do you feel highly energetic and find you need much less sleep than usual to feel rested?

No, it's definitely not driven by worry or anxiety—I actually feel incredibly energetic, like my body and brain are stuck in high gear. Most nights I only get about two or three hours of sleep, but I don't feel tired at all. I'm just completely wired and eager to keep working on my projects.
Have you ever had periods in your past where you felt the opposite of this—very down, sad, or lacking the energy and interest to do anything?

No, I haven't really had periods like that where I felt down or lacked energy in the past. My main struggle is the exact opposite—I just can't seem to slow down right now and feel constantly stuck in overdrive.
Is this the very first time in your life you've experienced a period of high energy and decreased sleep like this, or have you had similar 'up' phases in the past?

Yes, this is the very first time I've ever experienced anything like this. This whole "up" phase is completely new to me, and it's been going strong for about seven months now, ever since I started cramming for my Master Electrician exam and working on that big solar contract.
Has this constant high energy or your new projects caused any problems in your relationships, work, or finances, or have people close to you expressed concern?

Honestly, yes, it's caused some major issues. My boss actually pulled me off field work because clients complained and my crew felt unsafe, and my wife is furious about the credit card debt I ran up buying tools and solar inventory. She and the apprentices I mentor say they're actually scared by my intensity, which is why she insisted I come here.
Are you currently taking any prescription medications, over-the-counter supplements, or using any substances like stimulants to help you stay awake and study?
No, I'm not taking any prescription medications, supplements, or stimulants to stay awake. I do drink a lot of coffee to help me keep going when I'm working late in the garage, but that's about it.
Have you recently experienced anything unusual, like hearing voices others can't hear, or feeling like you have special powers or a unique connection to something greater?

No, I don't hear any voices or anything like that. But I absolutely feel like I am uniquely destined to revolutionize the solar and smart home industry around here. I'm able to see brilliant solutions and designs that ordinary electricians simply aren't smart enough to grasp.
